verdict.rationale: WooCommerce docs mention 'automated tax calculations' as a marketing feature and a core guide for enabling/configuring taxes and adding tax rates, but the evidence pack shows only manual tax-rate table setup, not per-jurisdiction automatic rate updates, VAT-specific handling, or built-in filing-ready tax reports. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic jurisdiction rate updates (e.g. via a tax service integration), VAT-specific compliance handling, and generation of filing-ready tax reports.
